Type-level range validation accepts invalid negative values `spec/​git-option-groups.json:284` The literal TypeScript path does not enforce this check: `ApplyBody` in `src/constraints/types.ts` falls through to `unknown` for `range` constraints. Consequently `git.command('log', [['--expand-tabs', -1]])` still type-checks even though runtime validation rejects it, so the new public typed scope does not preserve the stated runtime/literal parity. Add literal-aware range handling and a `@ts-expect-error` fixture for this case.
Type-level positive-number validation misses forbidden option ordering `spec/​git-option-groups.json:467` This transition is runtime-only in practice. For a `forbid` rule, the type-level `Reject` implementation maps the `positive` predicate to `unknown`, so `git.command('log', [['--skip', 1], ['--max-count-oldest', 1]])` is accepted by the public TypeScript API while `commandArguments` rejects it. Implement literal-aware positive-number handling and add a rejected compiler fixture for this ordering.

nodes.body: This drops the detached-value form that the newly added upstream inventory records for `--unpacked` (`spec/upstream/git-revision-options.json:961-965`). Consequently every new revision scope types this option as a flag and `commandArguments` rejects the valid `--unpacked=<object>` form as “this flag takes no value.” Model it as `optional-string`, regenerate the command artifacts, and cover both forms in the command/type fixtures.

The value candidate is a deliberately rejected spelling, not a supported grammar. In pinned Git 2.55 revision.c:2537-2540, bare --unpacked sets traversal state, whereas every --unpacked=<packfile> invocation dies with "no longer supported". The optional-string change would accept an invalid Git invocation. Commit a0eb951 adds native and compiler regression coverage for all six revision-group scopes: bare flags (with separate revision operands where appropriate) succeed, attached values fail with status 128, and value tuples are rejected. The new live probes pass under both Git 2.55 and legacy Git 2.25; full source/contracts pass. Inventory documentation now explicitly distinguishes candidates, including removed spellings, from valid argument forms. Source: https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.55.0/revision.c#L2537-L2540

**📐 Maintainability & Code Quality** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win**

**`implicit no-index dispatch` を `diff` 以外の行から削除してください。**

この項目は `diff` の暗黙的な no-index 解釈に関する残作業です。`diff-files`、`diff-index`、`diff-tree`、`log`、`show` にも記載すると、これらのコマンドに未完了監査項目があると誤って示します。該当する5行からこの項目を削除してください。

`diff --no-index` は独立したスコープとして記録され、専用文法も `src/commands/revision-diff.test.ts:254-270` でテストされています。
